customer_feedback.name: Customer Feedback
customer_feedback.description: Hear what customers think of your service, with a follow-up when someone is unhappy.

csat_nps.name: Customer Satisfaction (CSAT / NPS) Survey
csat_nps.description: Measure satisfaction (CSAT), effort and loyalty (NPS). Each answer is grouped as promoter, passive or detractor.

product_review.name: Product Review
product_review.description: Collect detailed product reviews with star ratings, an average score, photos and publishing consent.

contact_lead.name: Contact / Inquiry Form
contact_lead.description: A simple, friendly contact form that routes each inquiry by topic.

quote_request.name: Quote / Estimate Request
quote_request.description: Let customers build a request and see an indicative estimate from package, add-ons and quantity.

order_form.name: Order Form
order_form.description: Take orders with up to three product lines, delivery choice and a running total.

complaint_dispute.name: Complaint / Dispute Form
complaint_dispute.description: Record complaints and disputes with evidence, the outcome wanted and earlier contact.

service_request.name: Service Request
service_request.description: Book a service visit with priority, preferred time and photos of the problem.

lead_capture_newsletter.name: Lead Capture / Newsletter Signup
lead_capture_newsletter.description: Grow your list with consent, interests and campaign tracking built in.

return_refund.name: Return / Refund Request
return_refund.description: Handle returns with the reason, photos, the outcome wanted and the refund amount worked out.

job_application.name: Job Application
job_application.description: A complete application: personal details, the role, CV upload, salary expectation and consent.

employee_onboarding.name: Employee Onboarding
employee_onboarding.description: Everything a new starter shares before day one: details, emergency contact, equipment and payment.

exit_interview.name: Exit Interview
exit_interview.description: Learn why people leave and what would make them stay, with ratings across the employee experience.

leave_request.name: Leave / Time-Off Request
leave_request.description: Request leave with the number of days worked out from the dates, cover and supporting documents.

performance_review.name: Performance Review / Appraisal
performance_review.description: Rate six competencies; the average score and rating band are calculated for you.

engagement_survey.name: Employee Engagement Survey
engagement_survey.description: An anonymous pulse on pride, purpose, growth and support, with an engagement index from 0 to 100.

expense_reimbursement.name: Expense Reimbursement
expense_reimbursement.description: Claim up to three expenses with receipts; the claim total adds itself up.

timesheet.name: Timesheet
timesheet.description: Weekly hours per day with total and overtime against contracted hours.

training_feedback.name: Training Feedback
training_feedback.description: Rate the content, trainer, materials and relevance of a course, with an average score.

reference_check.name: Reference Check
reference_check.description: Structured questions for referees, rated skills with an average and a clear hire-again answer.

risk_assessment.name: Risk Assessment
risk_assessment.description: Score each hazard by likelihood × severity; the risk level is worked out and an action plan appears when the risk is medium or high.

incident_report.name: Incident / Accident Report
incident_report.description: Record what happened, who was hurt and the first actions taken. Serious incidents are flagged for urgent review.

near_miss_report.name: Near-Miss Report
near_miss_report.description: Report close calls quickly. Potential severity and recurrence give a priority so prevention comes first.

safety_inspection.name: Safety Inspection Checklist
safety_inspection.description: Pass / fail checks with a compliance percentage and result; failed checks ask for details and photos.

patient_intake.name: Patient Intake
patient_intake.description: New-patient details, reason for visit, pain level, allergies and BMI worked out from height and weight.

medical_history.name: Medical History
medical_history.description: Conditions, operations, medicines, family history and lifestyle, with a count of conditions for the clinician.

health_screening.name: Health Screening / Declaration
health_screening.description: A quick yes / no screening before entry; any "yes" refers the person for review before they go in.

consent_form.name: Consent Form
consent_form.description: Clear consent statements with signature; a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18.

event_registration.name: Event Registration
event_registration.description: Register attendees with ticket type, quantity and a running total, sessions and access needs.

rsvp.name: RSVP
rsvp.description: Simple yes / no / maybe replies with party size and dietary needs only for those coming.

appointment_booking.name: Appointment Booking
appointment_booking.description: Book a service on a preferred date and time, with a second choice and reminders.

venue_booking.name: Venue / Room Reservation
venue_booking.description: Reserve a room by the hour with equipment add-ons and a cost worked out as you choose.

volunteer_signup.name: Volunteer Signup
volunteer_signup.description: Collect volunteers, their interests and availability, with guardian consent for under-18s.

speaker_sponsor_application.name: Speaker / Sponsor Application
speaker_sponsor_application.description: One form for both: speakers propose a session, sponsors pick a package and add-ons with a total.

post_event_feedback.name: Post-Event Feedback
post_event_feedback.description: Ratings for content, speakers, venue and organisation with an average score and a recommendation.

guest_registration.name: Guest Registration Form
guest_registration.description: Check-in details with the number of nights worked out from arrival and departure.

hotel_booking_request.name: Hotel Booking Request Form
hotel_booking_request.description: Dates, room type and rooms give the nights and an estimated price; extras and special requests too.

guest_feedback.name: Guest Feedback Form
guest_feedback.description: Rate cleanliness, comfort, staff, food and value with an average and a recommendation.

service_evaluation.name: Service Evaluation Form
service_evaluation.description: Evaluate a department or team member on four qualities; the service score is shown as a percentage.

special_requirements.name: Special Requirements Form
special_requirements.description: Dietary and access needs, allergies and celebrations, so the stay is ready before arrival.

event_catering_request.name: Event Catering Request
event_catering_request.description: Menu and extras per head times the number of guests give an estimate straight away.

restaurant_reservation.name: Restaurant Reservation Request
restaurant_reservation.description: Date, time, party size, seating and the occasion: everything the host needs.

hospitality_complaint.name: Hospitality Complaint Form
hospitality_complaint.description: Let guests tell you what went wrong, where and how they would like it put right.

student_enrolment.name: Student Enrolment / Admission
student_enrolment.description: Student and guardian details, programme choice, previous education, documents and consent.

course_evaluation.name: Course Evaluation
course_evaluation.description: Students rate the course on six statements; an overall score shows how the course is landing.

quiz_assessment.name: Quiz / Assessment
quiz_assessment.description: Multiple-choice questions scored automatically, with a percentage and a pass mark.

scholarship_application.name: Scholarship Application
scholarship_application.description: Academic record, financial need and a personal statement, with an eligibility score for the panel.

permission_slip.name: Parent Consent / Permission Slip
permission_slip.description: Permission for a trip or activity with medical notes, emergency contact and a guardian signature.

attendance_register.name: Attendance Register
attendance_register.description: Mark up to eight learners present, late or absent; the present count and rate add up automatically.

academic_survey.name: Academic Survey
academic_survey.description: A short survey on study experience, support and wellbeing for students of any level.

it_support_ticket.name: IT Support Ticket
it_support_ticket.description: Report an IT problem; impact × urgency sets the priority so the right tickets go first.

change_request.name: Change Request
change_request.description: Describe a planned change with a risk score from impact and likelihood, a rollback plan and approval.

asset_checkout.name: Asset Check-out / Inventory
asset_checkout.description: Check equipment in or out with asset tag, condition, return date and signature.

work_order.name: Maintenance / Work Order
work_order.description: Request maintenance with location, priority and photos; hours and parts give the job cost.

purchase_requisition.name: Purchase Requisition
purchase_requisition.description: Request up to four items with quantity and price; the total decides which approval is needed.

vendor_registration.name: Vendor / Supplier Registration
vendor_registration.description: Company, contacts, tax and bank details (IBAN / SWIFT) and documents for supplier onboarding.

site_inspection.name: Site / Field Inspection Report
site_inspection.description: On-site pass / fail checks with a pass rate, an outcome, findings and photos.

proof_of_delivery.name: Delivery Confirmation / Proof of Delivery
proof_of_delivery.description: Confirm what arrived, its condition, a photo and the receiver’s signature. Damage asks for details.

quality_control.name: Quality Control Checklist
quality_control.description: Batch details, pass / fail criteria and measurements; the pass rate gives a release decision.

loan_application.name: Loan / Credit Application
loan_application.description: Applicant, employment and finances, with a debt-to-income ratio and an estimated monthly payment.

kyc_verification.name: KYC / Identity Verification
kyc_verification.description: Identity details, ID document and proof of address, with clear purpose and consent.

invoice_submission.name: Invoice Submission
invoice_submission.description: Suppliers submit an invoice with line items; subtotal, tax and total are worked out.

insurance_claim.name: Insurance Claim
insurance_claim.description: Policy, incident, evidence and itemised losses; the claim total adds up as items are entered.

nda_signoff.name: NDA / Agreement Sign-off
nda_signoff.description: Show the agreement, confirm each key point and sign, with company details when signing for one.

membership_application.name: Membership Application
membership_application.description: Join a club or association: member details, membership level, extras and the yearly fee.

donation_form.name: Donation Form
donation_form.description: A gift amount (or your own), monthly or once, with an option to cover the processing fee.

petition.name: Petition
petition.description: State the cause, collect names and locations, and let people say why it matters to them.

poll_ballot.name: Poll / Voting Ballot

note.oracle_new_tables: Tables added later need the grant too: run the block again, or use Oracle 23ai schema grants.
note.oracle_own_schema: Formalie's tables go in the account's own schema, so it needs no rights on your schemas to store responses.
note.owner_tables: Formalie owns the tables it creates, so it can read, write and add columns to them, and to nothing else in this schema.
note.own_schema: Formalie's tables go in a schema of their own that the account owns. Your other schemas stay untouched unless you grant more below.
note.mysql_database: MySQL and MariaDB grant per database, so these rights also reach your other tables in it. To keep Formalie to its own tables, give it a database of its own.
note.mysql_covered: Nothing more to run: the grants for Formalie's tables already cover this database. Add other databases above to grant them here.
note.owner_alter_other: New tables Formalie creates there are its own. To let it change an existing table, make the account that table's owner.
note.oracle_create_other: Before 23ai, Oracle can't grant creating tables in one schema only, so Formalie creates new tables in its own schema.

key.title: Formalie-Key
key.text: A new unique id for every POST: 16 to 100 characters, and a UUID works well (the examples make one for you). Simple patterns such as 1111… or 1234… are refused. If the network fails and you send the same POST again with the same key within 24 hours, Formalie answers with the record it already made; the same key with a different body is refused, so a reused key never loses a record. On other methods it is optional and only helps you find the call in Request logs.
